name: Piomin Spring Boot Template
description:
This plugin transforms Claude Code into a specialized Spring Boot development environment by providing:

1. Domain-specific agents - Expert personas for different aspects of development
2. Reusable skills - Pattern-based prompts for common Java/Spring Boot tasks
3. Project instructions - Consistent coding standards and workflow enforcement
4. Pre-configured permissions - Maven, Docker, Git operations allowed by default
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills** and **6 agents**.

- **Skills** (5): `code-quality` (Comprehensive code review for Java - clean code principles, API contracts, null safety, exception handling, and performance), `design-patterns` (Common design patterns with Java examples (Factory, Builder, Strategy, Observer, Decorator, etc.)), `jpa-patterns` (JPA/Hibernate patterns and common pitfalls (N+1, lazy loading, transactions, queries)), `logging-patterns` (Java logging best practices with SLF4J, structured logging (JSON), and MDC for request tracing), `spring-boot` (Spring Boot 3.x development - REST APIs, JPA, Security, Testing, and Cloud-native patterns)
- **Agents** (6): `code-reviewer` (Use this agent when you need to conduct comprehensive code reviews focusing on code quality, security vulnerabilities, and…), `devops-engineer` (Use this agent when building or optimizing infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization strategies, and deployment workflows to accelerate…), `docker-expert` (Use this agent when you need to build, optimize, or secure Docker container images and orchestration for production…), `kubernetes-specialist` (Use this agent when you need to design, deploy, configure, or troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters and workloads in production…), `security-engineer` (Use this agent when implementing comprehensive security solutions across infrastructure, building automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, or…), `spring-boot-engineer` (Use this agent when building enterprise Spring Boot 3+ applications requiring microservices architecture, cloud-native deployment, or reactive programming…)

Installs with `claude plugin install piomin-spring-boot-template@claude-community` from `piomin/claude-ai-spring-boot`.
